ValidationRule.description: Submitted orders require a positive amount.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Submitted"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Syncing"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Synced") ), OR(ISBLANK(Total_Amount__c), Total_Amount__c <= 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Total amount must be greater than zero before ERP sync.
